Guelph-Waterloo Centre for Graduate Work in Chemistry and Biochemistry
TWO GREAT UNIVERSITIES, ONE GREAT GRADUATE PROGRAM
About GWC2
The Departments of Chemistry (and Biochemistry) of the University of Guelph and of the University of Waterloo jointly offer programs leading to MSc and PhD degrees
Find Out More
The Programs
A diverse team of world-class faculty from Chemistry Departments at both University of Guelph and Waterloo University provide research opportunities in a myriad of chemical and biochemical research areas
Our Programs
Getting Started
One application + one application fee = an opportunity for admission to one of two great universities!
How to Apply
As a student looking for a graduate placement, you owe it to yourself to survey all possible venues for your studies
The Guelph-Waterloo Centre for Graduate Work in Chemistry and Biochemistry GWC2 is one of Canada’s largest and most successful graduate schools. The Centre is housed in the Chemistry Department at Guelph and the Chemistry Department at Waterloo, two of Canada’s highest rated Universities. A diverse team of world-class faculty from both Departments provides research opportunities in a myriad of chemical and biochemical research areas. Please survey our website to see the many areas.
Annual General Meeting
Thank you to all that attended the GWC2 AGM and awards presentation. Congratulations to all the award winners!
PhD Seminars
See upcoming PhD Seminars that are open to all GWC2 graduate students to attend. Come out to support your fellow students and check off a program requirement by attending a seminar.
Undergraduate Socials
You are invited to join information sessions sponsored by GWC2. These social gatherings, held once a year on both campuses (early Winter), provide an opportunity to meet faculty and current grad students to discuss research options.
We Offer The Best Chemistry
If one considers the comfortable and safe living environment of two mid-sized cities, the culture and sports activities, and the great sense of community within the Departments and the Universities, there lies a wonderful and fulfilling opportunity for study and growth.
